items.title: Spanish train crash death toll rises to 69 as rescuers search for victims
items.blurb: The crash, Spain’s second fatal high-speed rail accident this year, has killed 69 people and injured dozens, prompting a nationwide mourning period, a train drivers’ strike over safety funding and calls for a full…

items.title: Cyclone Arnab’s remnants raise landslide risk on Nepal’s main highways
items.blurb: Authorities have flagged key routes as vulnerable to landslides, rockfalls and flooding as the storm that struck India’s Andhra Pradesh coast weakens and brings rain to Nepal.

items.title: At least 68 people dead in Spain’s second major train crash this year
items.blurb: A Renfe train collided with a stationary Iryo service after being cleared to proceed despite a red signal, with 80 people injured and investigators probing a possible communications failure.

items.title: Annapurna Circuit sees trekking arrivals rebound after floods
items.blurb: More than 5,300 foreign tourists trekked the route during Dashain, 769 more than in the same period last year, as improving weather and repairs restored access.

items.title: Pakistan’s last-minute NOC demand hits NPL franchises hard
items.blurb: A sudden $25,000 fee requirement from the Pakistan Cricket Board forces NPL teams to scramble for emergency replacements, dampening global appeal and leaving fans disappointed.
